SELECT -- 邀请表的基础字段 inv.id, inv.work_id, inv.product_title, inv.product_description, inv.model_source, inv.cooperation_content, inv.keywords, inv.is_batch_production, inv.proofing_quantity, inv.delivery_limit_hours, inv.cancel_time_limit, inv.quoted_price, inv.quoted_period_days, inv.is_quote_batch_plan, inv.quote_submit_at, inv.tiered_pricing, inv.profit_share_ratio, inv.status, inv.created_at, inv.updated_at, inv.inviter_user_id, inv.invitee_user_id, inv.draw_number,
-- 关联查询【发起人】的用户信息 inviter.nick_name AS inviter_nick_name, inviter.avatar AS inviter_avatar,
-- 关联查询【被邀约人】的用户信息 invitee.nick_name AS invitee_nick_name, invitee.avatar AS invitee_avatar,
-- 关联查询【图片】信息 - 获取发起人的最新图片 (SELECT file_url FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE belong_user_id = inv.inviter_user_id ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS image_url, (SELECT category FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE belong_user_id = inv.inviter_user_id ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS image_type FROM sd_proofing_invitations inv LEFT JOIN -- 关联用户表，获取【发起人】的信息 sys_user inviter ON inv.inviter_user_id = inviter.user_id LEFT JOIN -- 关联用户表，获取【被邀约人】的信息 sys_user invitee ON inv.invitee_user_id = invitee.user_id WHERE -- 查询条件：我是【被邀约人】 inv.invitee_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY inv.created_at DESC

SELECT -- 邀请表的基础字段 inv.id, inv.work_id, inv.product_title, inv.product_description, inv.model_source, inv.cooperation_content, inv.keywords, inv.is_batch_production, inv.proofing_quantity, inv.delivery_limit_hours, inv.cancel_time_limit, inv.quoted_price, inv.quoted_period_days, inv.is_quote_batch_plan, inv.quote_submit_at, inv.tiered_pricing, inv.profit_share_ratio, inv.status, inv.created_at, inv.updated_at, inv.inviter_user_id, inv.invitee_user_id, inv.draw_number,
-- 发起人信息 inviter.nick_name as inviter_nick_name, inviter.avatar as inviter_avatar,
-- 被邀约人信息（当前用户） invitee.nick_name as invitee_nick_name, invitee.avatar as invitee_avatar,
-- 关联查询【图片】信息 - 获取发起人的最新图片 (SELECT file_url FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE belong_user_id = inv.inviter_user_id ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS image_url, (SELECT category FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE belong_user_id = inv.inviter_user_id ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS image_type
FROM sd_proofing_invitations inv LEFT JOIN sys_user inviter ON inv.inviter_user_id = inviter.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user invitee ON inv.invitee_user_id = invitee.user_id WHERE -- 查询条件：我是【被邀约人】 inv.invitee_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY inv.created_at DESC

SELECT -- 邀请表的基础字段 inv.id, inv.work_id, inv.product_title, inv.product_description, inv.model_source, inv.cooperation_content, inv.keywords, inv.is_batch_production, inv.proofing_quantity, inv.delivery_limit_hours, inv.cancel_time_limit, inv.quoted_price, inv.quoted_period_days, inv.is_quote_batch_plan, inv.quote_submit_at, inv.tiered_pricing, inv.profit_share_ratio, inv.status, inv.created_at, inv.updated_at, inv.inviter_user_id, inv.invitee_user_id, inv.draw_number,
-- 发起人信息（当前用户） inviter.nick_name as inviter_nick_name, inviter.avatar as inviter_avatar,
-- 被邀约人信息 invitee.nick_name as invitee_nick_name, invitee.avatar as invitee_avatar,
-- 关联查询【图片】信息 - 获取发起人的最新图片 (SELECT file_url FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE belong_user_id = inv.inviter_user_id ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS image_url, (SELECT category FROM sd_user_model_file WHERE belong_user_id = inv.inviter_user_id ORDER BY crt_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS image_type
FROM sd_proofing_invitations inv LEFT JOIN sys_user inviter ON inv.inviter_user_id = inviter.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user invitee ON inv.invitee_user_id = invitee.user_id WHERE -- 查询条件：我是【发起人】 inv.inviter_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY inv.created_at DESC

SELECT inv.id, inv.work_id, inv.product_title, inv.product_description, inv.model_source, inv.cooperation_content, inv.keywords, inv.is_batch_production, inv.proofing_quantity, inv.delivery_limit_hours, inv.draw_number, inv.created_at, -- 商家自己的报价信息 inv.quoted_price, inv.quoted_period_days, inv.is_quote_batch_plan, inv.quote_submit_at, inv.tiered_pricing, inv.profit_share_ratio, inv.status, CASE WHEN inv.selected_invitee_user_id = #{merchantId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_selected, inv.selected_at, -- 邀约人信息 inv.inviter_user_id, inviter.nick_name AS inviter_nick_name, inviter.avatar AS inviter_avatar, inviter.remark AS inviter_description FROM sd_proofing_invitations inv LEFT JOIN sys_user inviter ON inv.inviter_user_id = inviter.user_id WHERE inv.id = #{id} AND inv.invitee_user_id = #{merchantId}
